name: Passport to Romance
source:
You just landed an opportunity to travel to Europe! Now's your chance to find love, meet new friends, and live life to the fullest!

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Passport_to_Romance]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚获得了去欧洲旅行的机会！现在是你寻找真爱、结识新朋友并过上充实生活的机会！

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Passport_to_Romance]Choices Wikia[/url]]
